heroSection.heading:
Making credit easier 
 to access
heroSection.ctaCardText: BDC Capital Private Limited is a registered NBFC focused on helping individuals and businesses access formal credit through a transparent and responsible process.

aboutUsSection.sectionText: We help individuals and businesses access formal credit through a transparent and responsible lending approach. Formerly known as Pyar Finance Private Limited, BDC Capital Private Limited brings years of experience built on trust and long-term relationships.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: Our vision is to become a middle-layer NBFC by expanding geographically, increasing our customer base, and offering a wider range of financial services over time.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to enable access, availability, and affordability to the formal credit market for underserved sections of society, small business entities, and corporates.

ourValuesSection.sectionText: Our approach to lending is shaped by a set of core values that inform how we assess applications, engage with customers, and operate as a financial institution.

valuesData.title: Integrity
valuesData.description: Conducting business with honesty, fairness, and accountability.

valuesData.title: Customer responsibility
valuesData.description: Making lending decisions with long-term customer well-being in mind.

valuesData.title: Clarity
valuesData.description: Communicating information in a clear and understandable manner.

valuesData.title: Financial inclusion
valuesData.description: Supporting access to formal credit for underserved segments.

valuesData.title: Regulatory discipline
valuesData.description: Operating in line with applicable laws and regulatory expectations.

valuesData.title: Accountability
valuesData.description: Taking ownership of decisions, processes, and customer outcomes.

ourApproachSection.sectionText: Our lending approach focuses on understanding each application before determining suitable outcomes.

ourApproachCards.title: Providing guidance throughout the evaluation process
Maintaining consistency and transparency in decisions

commitmentSection.sectionText: We follow applicable regulatory guidelines and have adopted a Fair Practice Code to ensure ethical conduct and transparency across our operations.

commitmentPoints.title: Adherence to applicable regulatory and RBI guidelines
Adoption of a fair practice code.
Transparent communication throughout the lending process
Protection of customer information and data privacy
Defined grievance redressal and disclosure mechanisms

directorsCards.name: Ankur Rander
directorsCards.description:
At the core, I like creating things that go back into the world and become part of someone's everyday experience - something useful & beautiful. I care deeply about making systems simpler, clearer, and more effective than the ones we've learned to tolerate.

The next generation of digital products will be intelligent, behavior-aware, and designed to improve business outcomes while making life easier for people.

My perspective has been shaped by working across India, Stockholm, and Tokyo - experiences that sharpened my thinking on strategy, standards, and what people expect from the products they use every day.

At BOMBAYDC, we help organisations solve product problems and build digital platforms for the AI era.

At BRANDED, we help shape the brands behind them.

directorsCards.name: Siddhesh Pednekar
directorsCards.description: Siddhesh Pednekar is a Director at BDC Capital with extensive leadership experience across business strategy, corporate governance, and operational management. He plays a key role in guiding strategic growth, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving long-term value creation for the company.
